title: Remove profile completion popup

requirements.text: Remove the ProfileSetupModal component and all its imports from the application

quotes: Complete your profile pop up Wala bhi hata dijiye
Hn wahi hai aur ye popup ab kahi nahi dikhna chahiye

acceptanceCriteria: ProfileSetupModal component is completely removed from the codebase
No profile completion popup appears anywhere in the application
All references to ProfileSetupModal are removed from parent components

requirements.text: Remove any logic that triggers or checks for profile completion status

quotes: ye popup ab kahi nahi dikhna chahiye

acceptanceCriteria: No conditional logic exists that would show profile setup dialog
Application flow does not check for incomplete profiles
Users can access all features without being prompted to complete profile

constraints: Do not modify Internet Identity hooks or authentication components
Preserve all other user interface components and functionality
nonGoals: Changing any other authentication or access control features
